messages:
maria (eng-runtime): quick sync — we need a single error taxonomy and dashboard plan that covers runtime + infra inputs for timeouts, 5xx, OOMs, degraded-mode entries, and fallback counts. syncing with infra/observability because some signals live in proxies and some in workers. cc @raj @lee @elena
raj (eng-infra): +1. propose these canonical counters/gauges: `inference_request_timeout_total`, `inference_response_5xx_total` (label by `handler`), `gpu_oom_events_total`, `degraded_mode_entries_total`, `fallback_trigger_total` with labels: `model`, `route`, `region`, `tier`, `rollout_id`. runtime should emit at worker and proxy where applicable.
lee (eng-platform): watch cardinality — `rollout_id` and `request_id` are high-card. suggest `rollout_id` only on traces/drilldowns, and a hashed `rollout_bucket` (16 buckets) for dashboards. also want `cause` label for fallback (e.g., `quota`, `capacity`, `model_error`, `timeout`).
sam (eng-sre): dashboard UX reqs: overview (SLO-level rates + trends), incident triage page (top routes by error + recent traces), and per-region heatmap. alerts: use rate increases over baseline and absolute thresholds for OOM spikes. need playbook ties (what to do when fallback > 1% in 5m).
elena (observability): infra pipeline notes — we need structured events to kafka topic `inference.metrics.v1`. schema sketch (for instrumenters):
```json
{
  "ts": "iso8601",
  "metric": "string",
  "value": 1,
  "labels": {"model":"gptx-4-mini","route":"/chat","region":"us-west-2","tier":"paid","rollout_id":"r-2026-03-12"},
  "context": {"worker_id":"w-23","gpu_id":0}
}
```
we'll aggregate into Prometheus and also write raw events to bigquery for ad-hoc.
raj (eng-infra): additions: include `mem_free_bytes` and `mem_total_bytes` snapshots on oom events, and `batch_size` so we can correlate OOM with batching. please make `gpu_id` optional for private deployments (no GPU label if CPU-only).
maria (eng-runtime): agreed. prioritize these labels for dashboarding: `model_family`, `model_version`, `route`, `region`, `tier`, and `fallback_cause`. keep `rollout_id` out of overview but available in trace links.
deploy-bot: New rollout r-2026-03-12 deployed to us-west-2 (canary) :rocket:
lee (eng-platform): regarding sampling — emit full labelset for all events but mark `detailed=true` for a 1% sample stream to raw events so we can backfill without cardinality blowup in metrics store. dashboards read aggregated streams.
sam (eng-sre): need PromQL examples for on-call. rough fallback rate: `sum(rate(fallback_trigger_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(inference_request_total[5m])) by (route)` => per-route fallback ratio. also alert when `fallback_ratio > 0.01 and increase > 2x baseline`.
raj (eng-infra): example query for OOM spike (prometheus):
```promql
sum(rate(gpu_oom_events_total[5m])) by (region, model_family)
```
we should also expose `oom_per_100k_requests = (rate(gpu_oom_events_total[1m]) / rate(inference_request_total[1m])) * 1e5`.
maria (eng-runtime): action items: 1) runtime: emit events + labels (raj owner) — ETA 2w. 2) infra/obs: kafka topic + prom pipeline + sample stream (elena owner) — ETA 3w. 3) dashboards: overview + triage + per-route (lee/sam owners) — ETA 4w. 4) docs + playbook (maria) — ETA 4w. please ack or propose changes.
